name: Mada Tsuki ga Hohoemu Koro
source:
On a moonlit night, Nico, a boy who is unable to fall asleep, goes to his bedroom to think about ways to relieve his boredom. His imagination enriches his hours of solitude. After a while, Nico suddenly has an idea and decides to run away from home and go out into the city at night with great enthusiasm...

[From [url=https://yanagimoto.itch.io/when-the-moon-still-smiling]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
月夜，无法入睡的男孩尼科走进卧室思考如何排解无聊。他的想象力丰富了他独处的时光。过了一段时间，尼科突然灵机一动，决定怀着极大的热情离家出走，晚上进城……

[来自[url=https://yanagimoto.itch.io/when-the-moon-still-smiling]Itch.io[/url]]
